Services¶

Coordinate article approval, subscriber email, and authenticated API delivery.

news.services.approve_article(article_id, editor)[source]¶

Approve a story and create a durable delivery event in one transaction.

Parameters:

  • article_id (int) – Primary key of the article to review.

  • editor (news.models.User) – Editor requesting approval.

Returns:

The existing or newly created revision event.

Return type:

news.models.ApprovalEvent

Raises:

  • django.core.exceptions.PermissionDenied – The editor cannot review this story or attempts to approve their own work.

  • news.models.Article.DoesNotExist – The article identifier does not exist.

Network calls occur separately through dispatch_approval after commit.

news.services.dispatch_approval(event)[source]¶

Attempt unfinished email and API deliveries for an approval event.

Parameters:

event (news.models.ApprovalEvent) – Committed approval snapshot to deliver.

Returns:

Event with updated delivery status.

Return type:

news.models.ApprovalEvent

Recorded successful deliveries are skipped. Failed attempts retain a generic error and can be retried. This does not guarantee exactly-once delivery if a remote service accepts a request but the acknowledgement is lost.

news.services.send_newsletter(newsletter, user)[source]¶

Email approved newsletter content to the current subscribers.

Parameters:

  • newsletter (news.models.Newsletter) – Newsletter revision to distribute.

  • user (news.models.User) – Account requesting the send.

Raises:

  • django.core.exceptions.PermissionDenied – The user cannot edit the newsletter.

  • django.core.exceptions.ValidationError – No approved articles are selected.

Previously successful deliveries for the same revision are skipped.

HTTP API¶

POST /api/token/ with a username and password to obtain a private token. Use the Authorization header with the value Token YOUR_TOKEN.

Main endpoints¶

Method and path

Purpose

GET/POST /api/articles/

List approved stories; journalists can create drafts.

GET/PATCH/DELETE /api/articles/<id>/

Read or change a permitted story.

POST /api/articles/<id>/approve/

Editor approval with author and company checks.

POST /api/approved/

Record an event owned by the approving editor.

GET /api/articles/subscribed/

Reader’s subscribed feed.

GET /api/publishers/

Publisher directory.

GET/POST /api/newsletters/

List or create newsletters according to permissions.

GET/PATCH/DELETE /api/newsletters/<id>/

Newsletter detail and authorised changes.

GET /api/me/

Current user’s role and applicable fields.
